step-2016-p1-q2.summary: Let $S=\sqrt{1+x^2}$ and $L=\ln(x+S)$. For arbitrary real $a,b,c,d,e$, differentiate $(ax^2+bx+c)L+(dx+e)S$ and collect terms. Use the result to obtain antiderivatives of $L$, $S$ and $xL$.
step-2016-p1-q2.summaryZh: 记 $S=\sqrt{1+x^2}$、$L=\ln(x+S)$。设 $a,b,c,d,e$ 为任意实常数，求 $(ax^2+bx+c)L+(dx+e)S$ 的导数并合并同类项。进一步求 $L$、$S$、$xL$ 的原函数。
step-2016-p1-q2.answer: The three primitives, each up to a constant, are $xL-S$, $(xS+L)/2$, and $[(2x^2+1)L-xS]/4$.
step-2016-p1-q2.answerZh: 三个原函数依次为 $xL-S$、$(xS+L)/2$、$[(2x^2+1)L-xS]/4$，各式都可加任意常数。

methods.title: Collect coefficients over one square root
methods.titleZh: 把代数项通分，再比较系数
steps: Since $S>|x|$, the logarithm is defined on the real line. From $S\prime=x/S$ we get $L\prime=(1+x/S)/(x+S)=1/S$. The product rule therefore gives $(2ax+b)L+[(a+2d)x^2+(b+e)x+c+d]/S$.
For the integrand $L$, set $b=1,e=-1$ and all other coefficients zero. For $S=(1+x^2)/S$, choose $d=c=1/2$ and the others zero. These give the first two primitives.
For $xL$, set $a=1/2$, $b=e=0$, $d=-1/4$ and $c=1/4$. The polynomial over $S$ vanishes identically, leaving $xL$. The resulting primitive is the third displayed expression.
stepsZh: $S>|x|$，所以对数在实数轴上均有定义。由 $S\prime=x/S$，得 $L\prime=(1+x/S)/(x+S)=1/S$。应用乘积法则，导数为 $(2ax+b)L+[(a+2d)x^2+(b+e)x+c+d]/S$。
要让导数为 $L$，取 $b=1,e=-1$，其余为零。要让导数为 $S=(1+x^2)/S$，取 $d=c=1/2$，其余为零。这样得到前两个原函数。
要得到 $xL$，取 $a=1/2$、$b=e=0$、$d=-1/4$、$c=1/4$，则除以 $S$ 的多项式恒为零。代回原式，便得到第三个原函数。

step-2016-p1-q3.summary: On the closed interval $[-\pi,\pi]$, give four separate graphs for $\lfloor x\rfloor$, $\sin(\lfloor x\rfloor)$, $\lfloor\sin x\rfloor$ and $\lfloor2\sin x\rfloor$. Specify the value at every jump or isolated peak; $\lfloor t\rfloor$ is the greatest integer at most $t$.
step-2016-p1-q3.summaryZh: 在闭区间 $[-\pi,\pi]$ 上，分别画出 $\lfloor x\rfloor$、$\sin(\lfloor x\rfloor)$、$\lfloor\sin x\rfloor$ 和 $\lfloor2\sin x\rfloor$ 的图像。注明每个跳跃点和孤立峰值处的取值；$\lfloor t\rfloor$ 表示不大于 $t$ 的最大整数。
step-2016-p1-q3.answer: The first two graphs are constant between consecutive integers. For the latter two, the only positive isolated maxima are $1$ and $2$ respectively, both at $x=\pi/2$. All pieces and endpoint values are listed below.
step-2016-p1-q3.answerZh: 前两图在相邻整数间为常数。后两图在 $x=\pi/2$ 分别有孤立最高点 $1$ 与 $2$。下面列出所有分段及端点值。

methods.title: Find the integer thresholds of the inner function
methods.titleZh: 寻找内层函数经过整数的所有位置
steps: For each integer $j=-4,\ldots,3$, take $I_j=[j,j+1)\cap[-\pi,\pi]$. The first graph has height $j$ on $I_j$ and the second has height $\sin j$ there. The integer endpoint lies on the step to its right; the two domain endpoints are included.
For the third graph, $\sin x<0$ on $(-\pi,0)$, so the height there is $-1$. At $\pi/2$ it is $1$. The height is $0$ everywhere else, including $-\pi,0,\pi$.
For the fourth graph, solve $2\sin x=-1,0,1,2$. The height is $-2$ on $(-5\pi/6,-\pi/6)$; it is $-1$ on $(-\pi,-5\pi/6]\cup[-\pi/6,0)$.

The height is $0$ on $\{-\pi\}\cup[0,\pi/6)\cup(5\pi/6,\pi]$. It is $1$ on $[\pi/6,\pi/2)\cup(\pi/2,5\pi/6]$ and $2$ only at $\pi/2$. At a threshold the integer is taken exactly, which accounts for the open and closed endpoints.
stepsZh: 对 $j=-4,\ldots,3$，取 $I_j=[j,j+1)\cap[-\pi,\pi]$。第一图在 $I_j$ 上高度为 $j$，第二图高度为 $\sin j$。整数点属于右侧一段，定义域的两个端点都保留。
第三图中，$(-\pi,0)$ 上正弦为负，故取整后为 $-1$。$\pi/2$ 处为 $1$；其余位置均为 $0$，包括 $-\pi,0,\pi$。
高度 $0$ 对应 $\{-\pi\}\cup[0,\pi/6)\cup(5\pi/6,\pi]$；高度 $1$ 对应 $[\pi/6,\pi/2)\cup(\pi/2,5\pi/6]$；仅在 $\pi/2$ 取 $2$。达到整数阈值时直接取该整数，这决定了端点空心或实心。
